verdict.rationale: Synctera is an API-first banking platform. Its docs describe sandbox API keys and many API surfaces, including Internal Transfer, Webhook, verification and account creation. A probe confirmed a public OpenAPI spec at docs.synctera.com/openapi.json and an llms.txt index, which makes the API easy for an agent to discover and drive. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of API usage by third parties.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Once an API key is issued in Sandbox, you can immediately start calling the APIs below.
The [Internal Transfer API](/v2/reference/createinternaltransfer) allows you to transfer funds between two Synctera accounts, in real-time.
PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://docs.synctera.com/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
The Webhook API enables integrators to subscribe to specific events on the Synctera platform.
